notes.title: Ver 1.07 Update
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

Thank you for playing Hakoniwa Explorer Plus
An update just went live.

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where some of the weapons and armor had different effects to those in the descriptions. 
[*]Fixed a bug where some items disappeared after item altering events.
[*]Fixed a bug where you became unable to move when being attacked by a group of Womandrakes.
[*]Fixed a bug where if you used Items in the Item menu like Medicine, you wouldn’t get an Empty Bottle.
[*]Fixed a bug where the waiting time after defeating the Hidden Boss was too long.
[/list]

We hope you keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: Ver 1.06 Update

Dear Fans,

Thank you for playing Hakoniwa Explorer Plus
An update just went live.

[list]
[*]A bug where the text became blurry was not completely fixed, so we have made sure it is fixed.
[*]Fixed a bug where if you move back one map in the Riza Ruins, tree roots would become impassable and prevent progression.
[*]Fixed a bug that occurred when travelling to the final dungeon.
[*]Fixed the coordinates of the secret room exit in Maggy Volcano.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented entrance to the secret room in Totory Dunes.
[*]Fixed the visual effect when breaking parts of the map in overworld view.
[/list]

We hope you keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: [Touhou Luna Nights]100K Downloads! Thank You for Your Support! “Dash” Fixes & German Support Incl. in Update!
notes.content:
Dear players,
 
Touhou Luna Nights, which saw its final update roll out on June 15th, has officially topped 100,000 downloads!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cf141467679ffe57a92fb74a8cbc8e23c14594ac.gif[/img]
 
It’s thanks to the invaluable support and reviews of players like you that we were able to pass this significant milestone less than four months after the Ver. 1.0 release on February 26th. 
Thank you all so much!
 
Below we’ve got a comment received from the developers at Team Ladybug!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/afba758722711029623f4b8e40e44b50738e63f9.jpg[/img]
 
[i]To be honest, we are truly surprised by all the support we’ve received from so many players out there. We are extremely happy to see how much players like the graphics and game systems we’ve worked so hard to create. From here on out, we will continue to strive to create games enjoyable by both children and adults alike, and we greatly appreciate your invaluable and ongoing support.
-Team Ladybug[/i]
 
Also, we’ve implemented [b]fixes for the “Dash”[/b] feature that everyone requested.
 
1) Dash now ends when the lever is in neutral
2) Dash now ends and the character dodges backward when attacking and pushing the lever left or right during Dash
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/015243e64a091ff41527729fd9fa99291aec23cb.gif[/img]
 
Finally, we’ve also implemented the German language support we promised earlier.
 
There’s a brand new mode available after clearing Boss Rush, so keep playing Touhou Luna Nights and see if you can make it all the way through!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cc548ee0b2abc1bd8d0f9dfd7a2d011d245eb2ae.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/

notes.title: Differences from the Free Version
notes.content:
This version of the game has been significantly enhanced from the original free version, Hakoniwa Explorer.

Below are some of the differences from the free version.
[list][*]You can now select your character's gender! Various statuses will change between male and female characters.
[*]Selectable difficulty levels!
[*]A WHOLE BUNCH of additional items! Approximately 230% more than the free version!
[*]Changes to weapon shop specs: Hand over weapon/armor materials to have them leveled up and to increase the number of available items!
[*]Items change in accordance with some status ailments. For example, the "Burn" status ailment cooks raw meat, etc.
[*]Sukumizu has been powered up! She can hold onto your extra items for you, and more.
[*]Evil Sukumizu has also been powered up! Drop your guard and she'll force you to take out a loan and will continue bullying you to no end.
[*]New maps and dungeons! Now with approximately 30% more maps than the free version!
[*]Lots of newly added enemies, too! Approximately 40% more characters than the free version!
[*]A great big load of new villager dialogue has also been added! Added dialogue for every single character for when you jump on their heads, attack them, touch their butts, etc.
[*]Newly added BGM! The five brand-new tracks from Tatsuyuki Yoshimatsu really enliven the game!
[*]Changing weather! Weather on the world map now changes at random.[/list]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/705280/Hakoniwa_Explorer_Plus/
